title: Fueling Break - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Fueling Break is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Breaking a target doubles its Burn amount.

sections.title: Effect
sections.content: Breaking a target doubles its Burn amount.

sections.title: How to Get Fueling Break
sections.content: Location: The Continent - east of The Carousel; Endless Tower stage 7.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
